title: Franz Kafka's birth chart
metaDescription: Franz Kafka's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.1° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Gemini — Mercury, Venus, Saturn and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 11.1° of Cancer is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Mars in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 19.7° Gemini, Venus holds 19.8° Gemini, Mars holds 25.0° Taurus — in the old shorthand, thought that travels by comparison; attraction that begins as conversation; effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Mercury and Venus hold the closest angle here — a conjunction, 0.0° wide. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Venus square Uranus at 0.1°, and Mercury square Uranus at 0.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. Mercury in Gemini at 19.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Taurus at 25.0° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Cancer at 12.7° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 air, 3 earth, 2 water by element and 5 mutable, 2 cardinal, 2 fixed by mode. No settled placement falls in fire — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. The day carried no retrograde motion at all; everything moved forward as seen from here.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Gemini into Cancer during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.1° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
